scope: Local Linux subprocess ru_maxrss startup-watermark observation; no minimum-memory claim
procedure: Run the identical tiny native read twice through subprocess.check_output; retain a bytearray(0), then a bytearray(128*1024*1024), in the parent while launching the child. Read ru_maxrss from the child JSON and resource.getrusage in the parent.
interpretation: Child peak RSS retains a parent pre-exec watermark in this setup; small-case RSS is not interpreted as minimum reader memory. Large measured model allocations dominate this floor.
